name: Rafting Adventures
author: Addicting Games
description:
Rafting Adventures is a free avoider game. Rafting is an adventure made more fun by being an endless runner-style game. Yes, endless runners are fun but they're also a challenge for those of us who are used to games with definitive beginning middle, and an end.  The object of the game is to paddle as far as you can and as fast as you can without hitting a rock and thus dying. This risk-reward proposition is a big part of what makes endless runners so heckin' cool. They can be really fun, really addictive, and really frustrating. Rafting Adventures is an avoider and endless runner game where your only goal is to collect rubber duckies and stay alive. It is a sub-genre of platformers where you have to avoid obstacles and collect duckies without getting killed. There's also no time limit, so you're free to take as long as you want while collecting rubber duckies to boost your score. That's what makes this kind of game so hard — there is no time limit or health system, so when you die you die. There are no second chances and no one is coming to save you. It makes you truly feel the pressure because it's so easy to make mistakes.
Rafting Adventures is a game that, as the name suggests, turns rafting into an adventure. An endless adventure of avoidance and collecting things.  You play a rafter who is  dodging your way through a hostile environment. The object of the game is to raft along for as long as possible collecting ducks without dying. As you raft through the game, it becomes more difficult but also more rewarding. Show us what you got!
